profile_text.body:
Snap Inc describes itself as believing the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. The company says it contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.

Snap Inc is a for-profit public company headquartered in Santa Monica, California, trading under the ticker SNAP. Its SEC CIK number is 0001564408. The company has a California law exposure count of 281. No cases, products, or MCP servers are listed.
